---
title: "pressR foot pressure report"
output: html_document
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
params:
  trial: NULL
  masks: NULL
  thresholds: NULL
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(pressR)
```

```{r}
trial <- params$trial
```

## Trial

```{r}
.report_table(pr_report_info(trial))
```

## Summary

```{r}
.report_table(pr_summary_long(trial), digits=4)
```

## Maximum pressure picture

```{r, fig.alt="Maximum measured value at each sensor with the selected region boundaries."}
panels <- pr_plot_foot_report(trial, masks=params$masks)
panels[[1]]
```

## Regional maxima

```{r, fig.alt="Maximum measured values for the selected regions, with region names below the bars."}
panels[[2]]
```

## Force over time

```{r, fig.alt="Total force over time with detected stance intervals when physical calibration is available; otherwise an explicit unavailable notice."}
panels[[3]]
```

## Center of pressure

```{r, fig.alt="Center of pressure trajectory in the recorded coordinate units, colored by recording time."}
panels[[4]]
```

## Regional analysis

```{r}
.report_table(.report_regional_table(trial, params$masks), digits=2)
```

## Gait cycles

```{r, results='asis'}
if(all(is.finite(pr_calc_force(trial)))) {
  cycles <- pr_calc_gait_cycles(trial)
  cat(.report_table(cycles[c("cycle", "heel_strike_time", "toe_off_time", "stance_duration")],
    col.names=c("Cycle", "Heel strike (s)", "Toe off (s)", "Stance (s)"), digits=3), sep="\n")
  cat("\n\nFrame indices (one-based):\n\n")
  cat(.report_table(cycles[c("cycle", "heel_strike_frame", "toe_off_frame", "start_frame", "end_frame")],
    col.names=c("Cycle", "Heel strike", "Toe off", "Start", "End")), sep="\n")
} else {
  cat("Force-based gait detection is unavailable without physical calibration.")
}
```

## Interpretation and provenance

Unavailable physical quantities are labelled explicitly. Region definitions and
reference observations must match the acquisition and analysis context.
Exploratory bridge, slip and concentration settings are not diagnostic rules.

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$thresholds)) .report_table(params$thresholds)
```
